PORT.description: Public HTTP port. Railway routes the public domain to this port. Keep it equal to PDF2ZH_SERVER_PORT.

PDF2ZH_SERVER_PORT.description: Port the Web UI binds inside the container. Must match PORT. Defaults to 8080.

PDF2ZH_OLLAMA.description: Use the bundled Ollama sibling service as the translation engine.

PDF2ZH_OLLAMA_HOST.description: Ollama API base URL. Auto-linked to the sibling Ollama service's private domain over :11434.

PDF2ZH_OLLAMA_MODEL.description: Ollama model to translate with (e.g. qwen3:8b, gemma2, llama3.2). No model is pre-pulled — pull one first (ollama pull <model>). Leave empty to choose it in the Web UI.
